Role: Python Developer with Azure Databricks Exposure

Location: Not specified

Experience: 8+ years

Key Skills: Python, Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Django, Flask, FastAPI, React, Delta Lake, Azure




Job Description:




InfoBeans is seeking an experienced Python Developer with Azure Databricks exposure to design and build highly scalable applications and data solutions. In this role, you will leverage core Python, cloud services, big data frameworks, and web technologies to develop end-to-end applications, execute complex data analytics, and contribute to risk management solutions within the financial domain.




What will your role look like




• Develop highly scalable applications using Core Python and web frameworks like Django, Flask, or FastAPI.

• Perform data analytics tasks and execute complex SQL queries across relational and cloud databases.

• Work hands-on in the Azure Databricks environment utilizing PySpark, notebooks, integrated repos, job workflows, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog.

• Build and integrate interconnected Azure components including Azure Functions, App Service, Containers, Synapse Analytics, and API Management.

• Create custom visualization dashboards integrating Power BI with REST APIs.

• Orchestrate data integration workflows and manage code using Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, Git, GitHub, and Azure DevOps.




Why you will love this role




• Opportunity to work with state-of-the-art Azure cloud components, big data architectures, and Databricks workflows.

• Engage in high-impact projects within the financial sector, particularly in risk management.

• Thrive in an innovative and collaborative engineering culture that values continuous tech advancement.




We would like you to bring along




• 8+ years of prior experience as a developer working with required Python and cloud technologies.

• Strong proficiency in Core Python, scripting (PySpark, SQL, Bash), and web frameworks (Django, Flask, or FastAPI).

• Hands-on exposure to Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, and interconnected Azure infrastructure.

• Exposure to JavaScript technologies, preferably React.

• Highly desirable domain knowledge in Financial services, particularly Risk Management.

• Proficiency with version control systems and workflow orchestration tools like Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and Azure Data Factory.




About us




InfoBeans, founded in 2000, is a publicly listed company on the NSE & BSE in India, specializing in AI-first software development and implementation for enterprise clients to solve complex business challenges. We strive to deliver value-accretive services over the long term, working as an extension of our clients’ teams.




We are 1700+ members across our offices in India, the USA, Europe, and the Middle East. We believe that InfoBeans is our team’s second home and work hard every day to build a culture that fosters collaboration and excellence. InfoBeans Foundation, our CSR arm, helps underprivileged sections of society become employable through our free one-year training programs.




Creating WOW! is not just a tagline for us; it’s our religion!

jobs.description:
► Position Summary:


Benison Technologies is seeking an experienced, highly technical, and accomplished Golang/Python Developer with 4+ years of professional backend software engineering experience to join our core engineering team on a full-time, permanent basis in Bangalore or Pune (immediate joiners preferred). In this specialized backend and API engineering role, you will spearhead designing, building, and scaling high-performance REST APIs, robust microservices, and high-volume data processing pipelines leveraging AWS cloud services. You will work closely with software architects, cloud engineers, and product squads to deliver resilient backend systems. Ideal candidates bring a robust academic degree in computer science, deep practical mastery of Python and Golang, solid adherence to SOLID principles, and immediate availability for deployment in Bangalore or Pune.


► Detailed Job Description:


As a Golang/Python Developer at Benison Technologies in Bangalore or Pune, you will take full ownership of architecting, developing, testing, and deploying scalable backend services and distributed microservices. Your day-to-day responsibilities encompass writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code using Python 3 and/or Golang, designing secure REST APIs with robust authentication, authorization, error handling, retries, and idempotency, and managing cloud infrastructure on AWS (Lambda, ECS, containers, RDS). You will implement asynchronous processing workflows, optimize high-volume data pipelines, participate in code reviews, and drive software engineering excellence in a fast-paced technology environment.


► Key Responsibilities:


✓ Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable backend applications and microservices using Python 3 and/or Golang.

✓ Apply object-oriented programming (OOP), SOLID principles, and enterprise design patterns to ensure modular, maintainable codebases.

✓ Write exceptionally clean, robust, and well-tested code backed by comprehensive unit and integration test suites.

✓ Architect and build high-performance REST APIs featuring robust API security, token authentication, and role-based authorization.

✓ Implement resilient error handling mechanisms, retry policies, and idempotency guarantees for distributed transactions.

✓ Design highly reliable backend services capable of seamless fault tolerance and horizontal scaling.

✓ Build and manage cloud-native infrastructure on AWS, including Lambda functions, ECS containers, and RDS database instances.

✓ Implement complex asynchronous processing workflows, event-driven messaging, and high-volume data processing pipelines.

✓ Participate proactively in code reviews, architectural discussions, technical sprint planning, and CI/CD automation.

✓ Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, API specifications, and database schema mappings.


► Required Qualifications & Skills:


✓ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.

✓ Minimum 4+ years of professional software engineering experience focusing on backend development and API design.

✓ Deep technical mastery of Python 3 and/or Golang programming languages.

✓ Strong practical expertise in OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, and writing clean, maintainable code.

✓ Proven experience designing, building, securing, and documenting RESTful APIs and microservices.

✓ Solid working knowledge of API authentication, authorization, error handling, retries, and transactional idempotency.

✓ Hands-on cloud engineering experience with AWS services including Lambda, ECS (containers), and relational databases (RDS).

✓ Proven ability to implement asynchronous processing workflows and high-volume data processing systems.

✓ Professional availability for full-time employment in Bangalore or Pune, India (Application email: hari.prasad@benisontech.com; Immediate joiners preferred).


► Nice-to-Have Skills:


✓ Experience with advanced Python frameworks (Django, FastAPI, Flask) or Golang web frameworks (Gin, Fiber, Echo).

✓ Hands-on familiarity with message brokers and event streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS).

✓ Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis) and query optimization.

✓ Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).

✓ Prior working experience in product-based technology companies, fast-growing startups, or enterprise service firms.


► Application Information:


✓ Recruiter: Benison Technologies Recruitment Team

✓ Contact Name: Hari Prasad (Lead Recruiter)

✓ Email: hari.prasad@benisontech.com

✓ Phone: Unspecified

✓ Application URL: Unspecified

✓ Salary/Rate: Competitive and commensurate with experience

✓ Deadline: Open until filled

✓ Notice Period: Immediate joiners preferred

✓ Contract Duration: Permanent / Full-Time (Bangalore / Pune, India)

✓ Application Instructions: Interested candidates meeting all backend engineering criteria should send their updated resumes directly via email to Hari Prasad at hari.prasad@benisontech.com.


► Recruitment Pro Tip:


When applying for backend engineering roles in Golang and Python, ensure your resume explicitly highlights your distributed systems experience, AWS container deployment, and API idempotency implementation track record.
